description: (NH₄)₂NaFeF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight NH₄ clusters inside a NaFeF₆ framework. In each NH₄ cluster, N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the NaFeF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.40 Å. Fe is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Fe-F bond lengths are 1.90 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Fe atom.
